name: papercraft-poster
description: Create evidence-grounded interactive and print research posters from English text PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn research PDFs into reviewed interactive and A0 posters.
interface.longDescription: Runs the local PaperCraft engine with Codex account authentication to create source-grounded interactive, 16:9, and A0 research posters.
defaultPrompt: Use $papercraft-poster to turn my attached research PDF into a reviewed poster.
Use $papercraft-poster to make a Screen 16:9 and A0 poster from this paper.
